correctness.rationale: Exact DGDA update reduces to B=(1/2-i,1/2;1/2,1/2) and conjugate on every equal-singular-value bilinear mode. N=B-(1-i)I/2 has rank one, \(N^2=0\) and singular norm one, yielding \(B^k\) and a closed 2x2 singular value formula. The explicit comparison at k=0..3 plus a decreasing upper bound for k>=4 proves the unique global maximum. Synchronized state propagation gives the actual-variable 9/4 peak. The 209-check Python verifier agrees with direct real 4x4 and complex 2x2 powers; it is secondary to the analytic proof.

value.rationale: Provides a sharp algorithmically motivated finite-budget reliability benchmark for the source-recommended DGDA parameters on perfectly conditioned games. It isolates the distinction between spectral-radius convergence and transient Euclidean error, gives exact sharp peaks in full and synchronized states, and identifies a polynomial prefactor at the critical base that a pure geometric bound cannot absorb. It neither derives a routine step change nor asserts divergence.
